agent_priors_used: Agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): local continuation is a known failure mode of long-running autonomous research agents; a lane can make locally reasonable improvements while global program utility declines, so concentration flags justify a cognitive reset but never an automatic pivot.

Agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): measurement identifiability and baseline discrimination should be established BEFORE an expensive execution cycle; a treatment cannot demonstrate value against a comparator already at ceiling, and a threshold that no configuration can reach must be deleted before freeze rather than scored after it.

Agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): shared prerequisites should be repaired once in the substrate lane that owns them instead of being rediscovered as MEASUREMENT_INVALID independently in several lanes.

Agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): a construct that is unmeasurable by construction (e.g. a value-only channel whose transport validators are body-derived) can masquerade as a scientific absence; feasibility of the measurement population must be decided explicitly and fail loudly.

Agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): small quantized language models are markedly weaker at multi-step planning than at single-step format-constrained action emission, so a step-0 click followed by no answer is more plausibly a planning/prompt-specification limit than a formatting limit.

Agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): exploration/exploitation balance favors keeping a bounded, falsifiable, decision-changing probe in flight in a deliberately exploratory lane while the critical-path lanes do prerequisite repair.

allocation.rationale: This is readiness condition (1) and the audit's #1 priority. The audited capability lives only on a lane substrate: EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064 (audit PASS) ran a live, causally attributable distill_parameterized -> resolve -> execute path outside the synthetic fixture with honest counters and known-negative refusals, while main still exposes only literal distill() at confidence 0.5 and no distill_parameterized(), so resolve() cannot reach the execution threshold. Until the carrier is shipped, every downstream claim (C-LLM-INHERIT, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY, C-PRODUCT-ECON) is blocked at the same point, and the four-arm benchmark would be testing a treatment that the shipped product cannot execute.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: 434 canonical experiments, coverage gaps 0, 2 quarantined. All six lanes have an in-flight transaction: physics holds a FROZEN packet (EXP-PHYSICS-37992957068) that must complete under its frozen design; graph, runtime, product, intel and frontier each hold a PREFREEZE experiment mandated last cycle. No lane is idle. The decisive missing proof is unchanged: no canonical packet validates the chain observe -> parameterized mechanism -> executable binding in the SHIPPED treatment -> applicability/freshness decision -> real external-agent action -> lower end-to-end cost per successful partially novel task after retrieval/verification/repair/maintenance. That chain is gated by three readiness conditions, none of which currently holds in accepted evidence: (1) the shipped kernel still lacks the audited parameterized carrier (main exposes literal distill() with confidence 0.5 and no distill_parameterized(); EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064 is live only on a lane substrate, and B1 is the audit's #1 blocker); (2) the credential-free deterministic REST families used so far put COLD and RETRIEVAL-SHAPED at the 1.0 correctness ceiling at novelty >= 0.5, so the parameterized treatment cannot be distinguished (EXP-PRODUCT-37982016598, EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440); (3) no provisioned credential-free endpoint has yet driven the minimal multi-step Web-agent capability test (EXP-INTEL-37973264582, EXP-INTEL-37982024058, 0/5 and 0/5). Accordingly Product attacks (1), Runtime attacks (2) and Intel attacks (3); none of them funds the full C-LLM-INHERIT four-arm benchmark or a C-PRODUCT-ECON/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY economics benchmark, which stay barred until all three conditions hold. Physics completes its frozen transaction on the orthogonal access-barrier observable (onset/recovery of 403/429/transport barriers) rather than re-running the now-closed value-predictability axis. Graph continues the bounded C-FRESHNESS D1V identifiability question, because the incumbent value-blind guard's false-accept differential is structurally unmeasurable without a non-degenerate multi-anchor value-only-rotation population; the mandate is design-contract v2 and carries an explicit fail-loud escape to PARK plus redirect, which bounds the cost of a third feasibility attempt. Frontier continues the site-native discovery cost question, which can invalidate the path-persistence premise outright at credential-free GET-only cost instead of presupposing it. First-party C-PRODUCT-ECON quantities (h(N), Cwrite, Cmiss, cost per successful task) remain the next-priority item after the readiness chain and are deliberately NOT funded this cycle, because they are blocked on the shipped carrier and on a task population that does not yet exist. Concentration flags on graph, runtime and physics were treated as diagnostic only: each flagged lane received a genuine cognitive reset and its inherited direction was kept only where it still won on the merits. Cross-lane dependency shape: Product(B1) and Runtime(B2) and Intel(B3) are mutually independent and all three are preconditions for the same flagship benchmark; Graph and Physics run in parallel off the critical path; Frontier is orthogonal and may falsify the persistence premise before the flagship spends an EXECUTE cycle.
